name: Ratio Estimator for Volume Scattering
definition: A method to estimate radiance by separating the integral into an unoccluded analytic term and a numerical ratio of occluded to unoccluded estimates, allowing asymptotic convergence to the correct solution.
summary: The Ratio Estimator for Volume Scattering is an unbiased Monte Carlo technique that computes single-scattering radiance by multiplying an analytic unoccluded term by a numerically estimated visibility ratio.
